mode: Unity Editor / PhysX manual simulation; no rendering or play-mode collision callbacks

tests.name: Structure
tests.detail: 41 bodies, 39 bounded joint motors; arms and fingers dynamic.

tests.name: Skinned renderer
tests.detail: The active visible skin directly references physical Rigidbody transforms.

tests.name: No animated visible skeleton
tests.detail: No Animator or runtime source-model bone follower is present.

tests.name: Realistic textured human
tests.detail: Microsoft Rocketbox upper-body skin, with body/head/hair texture materials.

tests.name: Visible hands and every finger segment
tests.detail: 32/32 hand and finger bodies influence retained visible geometry.

tests.name: Hardware channel structure
tests.detail: Per side: 7 arm + 6 hand inputs; wrist has only two driven axes; controller ports are provisional.

tests.name: Servo endpoint/direction conversion
tests.detail: All 26 channels round-trip in both direction conventions; this is not hardware calibration.
